# # Example 16

If \( (S, *) \) is a semigroup, \( a \in S \), and \( T = \{a^i \mid i \in \mathbb{Z}^+\} \), then \( (T, *) \) is a subsemigroup of \( (S, *) \).

If \( (S, *) \) is a monoid, \( a \in S \), and \( T = \{a^i \mid i \in \mathbb{Z}^+ \text{ or } i = 0\} \), then \( (T, *) \) is a submonoid of \( (S, *) \).
